summary: Phase 1 fails on one blocker. Acceptance 2, 3, 4, and 8 hold in the preview folder. The five test files pass at 80c17f5, and bash -n passes. Acceptance 5 is incomplete: no test asserts "no pick yet", and a work type that only the unknown or other route carries disappears from the page with no "no pick yet" line (PA1-1). blocking_findings:
PA1-1 [Major] acceptance 5, last clause (spec D16 'No data' at measure/tracks/model_guide/spec.md:677 and :965-966): 'A work type with no row says "no pick yet"'. harness/model-guide/preview.sh:299-300 prints `

no pick yet

` only when the whole work_types map is empty. harness/model-guide/real-work.ts:409-410 skips the unknown and other rows before it collects the work-type names, so a work type that only those rows carry gets no table and no "no pick yet" line. Probe: the fixture with the unknown row given work_types {"translation": ...} (new MANIFEST.txt in a temp folder) gave exit 0 and work_types keys ['app code', 'docs and ops', 'print books', 'tooling']; 'translation' disappeared. No test in harness/model-guide-tests/ contains the text 'no pick yet' (grep), so the clause has no test, also for the empty-map branch. The plan Verify line of Phase 1 names acceptance 5. The real 2026-11-14 export has rows for all 5 work types, so the preview page shows no wrong value today. Fix route: Red adds tests in preview-gate.test.ts (or real-work.test.ts) that (a) an export with no work-type rows renders "no pick yet" and (b) a work type that only the unknown or other route carries renders a heading for that work type and "no pick yet" and no table; Green then makes real-work.ts keep the name with an empty row list and makes preview.sh render "no pick yet" for each work type with no row. Default reading: each work type of the export work_types keys gets a section. If the orchestrator rules that work types come only from ranked rows, Red still adds test (a), and the plan records the ruling.
